candidates.name: OGC Web Coverage Processing Service (WCPS) Standard
verified_facts: OGC WCPS defines a language for extraction, processing and analysis of multi-dimensional coverages.
WCPS operates on coverage data representing sensor, image or statistical information.
semantic_limits: Server-side processing can transform or subset source coverages but cannot improve unverified source accuracy or replace parcel-specific provenance.

candidates.name: OGC Web Map Tile Service (WMTS) Standard
verified_facts: OGC WMTS standardizes serving digital maps using predefined image tiles.
WMTS complements WMS by standardizing which pre-rendered map images a client can request.
semantic_limits: Map tiles are visualization products and must not be treated as raw numeric elevation measurements or accuracy evidence.
